reason: A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds 19 selectable light/dark visual themes, custom branding controls, and optional displayed brand-term mapping.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 19 种支持明暗模式的主题，并支持自定义品牌元素与可选的界面品牌词映射。
summaries.en: Adds 19 light-and-dark themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with customizable branding and optional displayed brand-term mapping.

capabilities: Applies selectable light and dark UI themes
Provides customizable branding elements and theme-aware colors
Persists theme and branding preferences in application settings
Optionally replaces configured brand terms in displayed interface or output text
